name: loader-spinner
title: Loader Spinner
description: A thin ring whose arc stretches and shortens as it turns, for waits of unknown length. It only appears after a short delay, so fast loads never flash a spinner.

meta.reducedMotion: The ring holds still at three-quarters and the label is shown; nothing turns.
meta.useWhen: A wait you can't measure (a search, a payment check) inside a button, a panel or a page area.
meta.avoidWhen: Waits you can measure (show progress instead); content loading where the layout is known (use Loader Skeleton); whole-page splash screens.
